independent_oracle.force: CCSD(T)-corrected Lambda supplied to analytic gradient.

limitations: Separate allocations on shared nodes; one cold/changed sample and two warm samples per variant, without interleaved confidence intervals.
Memcheck timing is retained but excluded from speed comparisons.
The flat n^4 grid and dense bytes remain; scatter stores include same-thread duplicates for repeated indices.
The reference cache ends after each standalone RHF call; the MO provider builds its own source.
Public CCSD(T) forces remain limited to 28 AOs. No 56-AO degenerate response extension is qualified.

measured_source.explanation: Native sources match the code commit. The frozen tree predates the Agent Note and API-only corrections to the new GPU test; the successful test bytes are identified separately.

qualification.native_resource_probe_origin: Compiled locally with ccache for #1728; unchanged internal ABI and test source, executed against the frozen candidate library. Exact budgets, allocation failure, physical CPU parity, changed geometry and d fallback.

timing_boundary: Complete prepared energy or energy+forces endpoint, cold/twice-warm/changed atom 1 z by +0.01 Bohr. Preparation is separate.
work_interpretation: Each list follows cold/warm/warm-repeat/changed. Contractions count one representative per exact AO permutation orbit, not primitive work. Dense values/bytes and full-grid launched threads are unchanged. All public CC work counters are unchanged. The baseline contracted every dense slot; its count is derived from the retained producer source, not a retrospective new journal field.
